title: Expand SRD table coverage beyond current imported tables
description:
Problem
Only a small number of table records are emitted even though the SRD source contains many mechanically meaningful tables.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
The canonical pack contains only 8 table records, while many source tables remain uncaptured, including but not limited to:
- Character Advancement
- Multiclassing prerequisites/proficiencies
- Languages
- Services and spellcasting services
- Magic item and monster rules tables
- Class/subclass-related tables that should be either structured or explicitly excluded from generic table import

Required behavior
- Decide which source tables should become standalone table records versus structured fields inside other records.
- Emit standalone table records for mechanically meaningful tables not otherwise captured.
- Add coverage so new omissions are visible.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: PR #185 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/185) opened, awaiting review. Emitted the 5 Beyond-1st-Level table records (Character Advancement, Multiclassing Prerequisites/Proficiencies, Standard/Exotic Languages); table count 8->13. Remaining source tables (Standard Exchange Rates, Trade Goods, Lifestyle Expenses, Food/Drink/Lodging, Services) registered in SRD_5_1_SOURCE_TABLE_GAPS so the audit reports them as missing-coverage; deferred to eshyra-0m9.19. Do not close until PR merges.
close_reason: Imported the 5 Beyond-1st-Level SRD tables (table count 8->13) via PR #185, squash-merged to main. Remaining money/downtime source tables tracked in SRD_5_1_SOURCE_TABLE_GAPS and deferred to eshyra-0m9.19.
